subject: prd/local-git-codehost
statement: Pack and verify a candidate artifact set from the intended merged release commit, pin it in AEC through the local artifact-source override, and run DOD-4 before publication. The final tag must point to the same commit and publish that same verified set; AEC then repins the published source and runs installation smoke checks. Any changed commit or artifact hash requires repeating the installed proof.
rationale: The final release cannot be a prerequisite of its own installed acceptance test.
